lays_out: {day} - the author spoke {author} time(s), the agent {agent}
query:
SELECT left("at", 10) AS day, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "by" = 'the author') AS author, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "by" = 'the agent') AS agent
FROM turns GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
title: day by day ({count})

query:
SELECT id, left("at", 10) AS day, left(regexp_replace("text", '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 150) AS said
FROM turns WHERE "by" = 'the author' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 12
title: what the author said, the latest first ({count})

lays_out: {turns} turns over {days} days, {first} to {last}; {author} of them the author's
query:
SELECT count(*) AS turns, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "by" = 'the author') AS author, count(DISTINCT left("at", 10)) AS days,
       min(left("at", 10)) AS first, max(left("at", 10)) AS last FROM turns

query: SELECT id, name, kind, CASE WHEN coalesce(also, '') <> '' THEN ' - also ' || also ELSE '' END AS known FROM people ORDER BY seq
title: who takes part ({count})

query: SELECT id, holds, "at" AS place, read FROM surfaces WHERE coalesce(read, '') <> '' ORDER BY seq
title: read now, and by which way in ({count})

query: SELECT id, holds, "at" AS place, lacks FROM surfaces WHERE coalesce(read, '') = '' ORDER BY seq
title: not yet read - and what is lacking ({count})

query: SELECT id, left(coalesce(practice, name || ': ' || description), 170) AS said FROM practices ORDER BY star, id
title: how work is done here ({count})

query:
SELECT e.from_id AS practice, e.to_star || '/' || e.to_table || ':' || e.to_id AS thing, coalesce(t.says, '') AS says
FROM edges e LEFT JOIN things t ON t.id = e."to" WHERE e.how = 'shown_in' AND e.from_table = 'practices' ORDER BY e.from_id, thing
title: shown in what was decided or said ({count})

lays_out: {practices} practices; {shown} say where they are shown
query:
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM practices) AS practices,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT "from") FROM edges WHERE how = 'shown_in' AND from_table = 'practices') AS shown
